passage.label: Winds scattering dispersing; clouds carrying load water; ships sailing ease; angels apportioning matter; indeed promised true recompense occur; heaven containing pathways; indeed differing speech; deluded away Quran deluded; destroyed falsifiers; within flood confusion heedless; ask when Day Recompense; Day tormented Fire; taste torment impatient; righteous among gardens springs; accepting Lord given doers good; sleep little night; hours before dawn ask forgiveness; properties right petitioner deprived; earth signs certain; yourselves will you not see; heaven provision whatever promised; by Lord heaven earth indeed truth just as sure speaking

arabicExcerpts.text: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ

mainSubject.label: Four oaths by winds scattering, rain-bearing clouds, smooth-sailing ships and apportioning angels grounding the certainty of the promised recompense; the pathway-containing heaven sworn against their differing speech; the deluded turned away from the Quran while falsifiers are destroyed in confused heedlessness; the Day of Recompense named as their torment-in-Fire day where they taste what they were impatient for; the righteous placed among gardens and springs having accepted their Lord's gift as prior doers of good who slept little at night, sought forgiveness before dawn and gave the needy their due from their wealth; signs on earth and in themselves offered to the certain, with provision and promise located in heaven; oath by the Lord of heaven and earth affirming it as truth equal to the certainty of their own speech

Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Lord-of-heaven-and-earth oath (23) before the Abraham-guests narrative opens (24); P2 ends with Noah's people as defiantly disobedient (46) before the cosmic-signs block begins (47); P3 runs from heaven-construction through the reminder-benefits-believers close (47-55); P4 covers the worship-purpose declaration through the closing woe (56-60).
